Design.evidence_source: [page/10/Text/2] Overall we had 592 participants (289 female) who were randomly drawn from a subject pool of over 3.000. Each session involved 16 to 32 participants and they were not allowed to take part in more than one session.

country.evidence_source: [page/10/Text/2] The experimental sessions took place at the Cologne Laboratory for Economic Research (CLER) from August 2010 to April 2011.

info_cost.evidence_source: [page/11/Text/1] In addition in the other three treatments a proposer had to decide on whether to reveal the true state of nature or not.
